scenes.say: Thinking of switching to contact lenses? Do this first.

scenes.en: Your contact lens power can differ from your glasses power.
scenes.say: Get an eye test first. Your contact lens power can be different from your glasses power, because the lens sits right on the eye.
We stock Acuvue, Bausch and Lomb, Alcon, CooperVision, and Freshlook.

scenes.en: We help you pick what suits your eyes and routine.
scenes.say: Daily, monthly, or coloured lenses. We help you pick what suits your eyes and your routine.

scenes.en: Wash hands. Fresh solution. Never sleep or swim in lenses.
scenes.say: Golden rules. Wash and dry your hands, use fresh solution every time, and never sleep or swim in your lenses.

scenes.en: Tap water can carry germs that cause serious eye infections.
scenes.say: Did you know? Tap water can carry germs that cause serious eye infections. So never rinse your lenses with water.

scenes.en: Red, painful or blurry eye: remove the lens, see an eye specialist.
scenes.ta: கண் சிவந்து வலித்தால் லென்ஸைக் கழற்றி உடனே கண் மருத்துவரிடம்
scenes.say: If your eye turns red, painful, or blurry, remove the lens and see an eye specialist urgently.

scenes.en: Get contact lens advice at our store.
scenes.say: Visit our store for a free eye test and contact lens advice.
